date_note: APA's page is stamped 24 November and gives no earlier day for the press conference.
exec: US officials say a record sum was returned to cyber-fraud victims since early March, as reported by Azerbaijani outlets.
geo_basis: US Department of Justice, Washington; the page names no location for the press conference
plain: APA reports that US Attorney General Todd Blanche said a record amount was returned to cyber-fraud victims since early March, after a presidential executive order.
summary: APA reports that US Attorney General Todd Blanche said a record amount was returned to cyber-fraud victims since early March, following a presidential executive order against cyber fraud. APA also reports criminal cases opened across US federal districts. Trend reports the same. Exact figures differ in wording between the two and were not carried here; no US government page was read.
title: APA: US Attorney General says record sum returned to cyber-fraud victims since March

validation.note: APA.az and Trend (Azerbaijan) both relay the press conference, probably from one source; no US Department of Justice page was found or read.

review.note: Compared Blanche statement, record, since March, executive order, cases across districts against APA and Trend
